subject: Enterprise access governance handoff — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist kickoff
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@globex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Enterprise access governance handoff — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist kickoff

Hi Sara —

Thanks for choosing Redwood. As we move into the implementation phase, I want to align on access controls so the CS handoff is seamless. Below is a compact checklist we typically lock down during onboarding for enterprise tenants: 

- SSO/SAML: IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL, certificate), required attributes (email, firstName, lastName), desired authnContext.
- SCIM: SCIM provisioning enabled? preferred SCIM token creation flow and expected attribute mapping.
- IP allowlist: CIDR ranges for customer network egress (API webhook sources, admin access).
- Service accounts: will you need dedicated service accounts for automated uploads or ingest jobs?
- Org policies & admin roles: which users should be Org Admins vs Billing/ReadOnly?

Can you share the IdP metadata XML, an initial list of CIDR ranges, and the admin contact for Marissa to schedule a technical kickoff? I attached a minimal checklist that Marissa will use during the runbook.

Attachments: rdw-saml-checklist.xlsx (runbook checklist stub)

Goal: Have a tech kickoff this week and complete SSO + SCIM by next week if possible. If dates don't work, propose alternatives.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@globex.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Team <it@globex.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 12:05:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Enterprise access governance handoff — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist kickoff

Hi Rishi —

Thanks — happy to get this rolling. Quick answers below:

- IdP: Okta (org: globex.okta.com). I attached our IdP metadata XML (globex-idp-metadata.xml).
- SCIM: We can enable SCIM. We prefer that Redwood generate the SCIM token and we will approve it through our IT portal.
- IP allowlist: Our egress ranges (for management console and webhooks): 54.210.0.0/16, 3.134.128.0/18, and 34.220.0.0/15.
- Service accounts: Yes — we'll create two service accounts: ingestion-svc@globex.com and analytics-svc@globex.com. They will need Org App access and restricted admin for token management.
- Admins: Primary admin is myself (sara.connors@globex.com). Secondary admin is IT Ops lead (it@globex.com).

We can take a kickoff Wed 20 May at 10:00 AM PT. I prefer sessions to be limited to 60 minutes so we can review SAML wiring, SCIM attribute mapping, and IP allowlist validation.

Attachments: globex-idp-metadata.xml (IdP metadata)

Best,
Sara
Director, Infrastructure — Globex Corporation
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@globex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enterprise access governance handoff — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist kickoff

Sara —

Appreciate the quick details and the metadata file. Marissa will take lead on the technical onboarding. Action items I have scheduled: 

1) Marissa to run SAML test flow and confirm attribute mapping (email required).
2) Enable SCIM provisioning in test mode and share token via secure upload once approved by Globex IT.
3) Validate and register IP ranges in the console; confirm that those ranges only permit admin console access + webhook endpoints.
4) Create two service accounts in Redwood tenant with the requested roles; we will provide onboarding tokens and rotate policy guidance.

Marissa — please pick up and create INF ticket for the implementation (link to HubSpot and Jira in metadata), then schedule the 20 May kickoff with Sara (10:00 AM PT).

Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/setup/saml-scim — this has the mappings we usually recommend. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@globex.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enterprise access governance handoff — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist kickoff

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the details — I'll run the SAML test and the SCIM provisioning flow. Next steps from my side: 

- I'll open INF-6721 to track the work and post updates there (https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-6721).
- Please confirm the preferred SAML NameID (email or transient); we default to email.
- I'll prepare the SCIM token request and send the token upload link (secure) for Globex IT to approve.
- I'll validate the IP ranges and tag them in the tenant; if connectivity tests fail, I'll propose tunneling options for webhooks.

Proposed kickoff: Wed, 20 May 2026 — 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET — 60 minutes. Agenda: SAML wiring (15m), SCIM attribute mapping (20m), Service accounts & token management (10m), IP allowlist verification & next steps (15m).

Please confirm and I will send a calendar invite.

On Mon, May 18, 2026 at 09:12 -0700 Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> Thanks for choosing Redwood. As we move into the implementation phase, I want to align on access controls so the CS handoff is seamless...

Regards,
Marissa Cole

Marissa / Rishi —

Thanks — Wed 20 May at 10:00 AM PT works for me. Confirming:

- NameID: email is fine.
- We'll approve SCIM token via our IT portal; please send the token request link.
- Service accounts: ingestion-svc@globex.com and analytics-svc@globex.com — please provision with Org App access.
- Attached network allowlist (network-allowlist.csv) with a couple of additional CIDRs; we will also whitelist the Redwood console IPs you provided in the docs.

One ask — any chance we can get a short runbook for emergency token rotation and a 15-minute walk-through on that during the kickoff? We need to document the operational steps for our audit team.

Attachments: network-allowlist.csv

See you on Wednesday.

Sara Connors
Director, Infrastructure — Globex Corporation
sara.connors@globex.com
